title: Place a resting limit order
description: Web Terminal block (testnet): reload the order page (Reduce only is not kept across a reload; the market is checked), clear any TP/SL the form kept, place one limit order on the requested side at the caller's price (optionally reduce-only), confirm the agent approval when it is the first write, and prove exactly one matching limit order rests on the venue at that price with the requested reduce-only flag. Leaves the order resting; the caller cancels or cleans.

fresh_page.intent: Start from a freshly loaded order form on the requested market

tab_limit.intent: Switch the order form to a limit order

no_tpsl.intent: Make sure the limit order carries no TP/SL kept from an earlier order

enter_limit.intent: Enter the trader's limit level in the order form

enter_size.intent: Enter how many dollars the trader commits

choose_reduce_only.intent: Mark the order reduce-only only when requested

reduce_only.intent: Make the order only reduce the open position

reduce_only_on.intent: Confirm the reduce-only box is ticked

choose_approve.intent: Confirm the agent approval only on the session's first write

approve.intent: Approve the trading agent in MetaMask the first time the trader writes to the venue

resting.intent: Prove the agent-signed limit order rests on the venue at the trader's price

resting_proof.intent: Bind the proof to the venue read: exactly one matching limit order rests

capture.label: order-limit-{{params.side}}
capture.intent: Keep a picture of the order page with the resting order

signer.description: extension: the real MetaMask extension confirms every wallet request (acceptance mode). injected: the strict test wallet signs in the harness (fast mode).

account.description: Wallet fixture account reserved for this slot (dev1 on mmt-1, Trading on mmt-2).

market.description: Testnet market reserved for this run.

notional.description: Order amount in USD typed into the order form; at least the venue minimum.

limit_price.description: Limit price far enough from the mark that the order rests (below for long, above for short).

reduce_only.description: true: tick Reduce only (needs an open position on the opposite side).

approve_agent.description: true when this submit is the session's first write: confirm the one ApproveAgent request (MetaMask in extension mode) before the venue check.
